title: StockSmart Bins behind VendPoint Substitute Selections — Settling Par Note
content:
Note on how a StockSmart Vendor-Managed Inventory Program at the machine's ship-to acts on the settling par of a Corbett-placed substitute on a VendPoint Industrial Vending Program machine.

The storeroom backup factor follows the StockSmart program whose status is active at the machine's ship-to: when that program carries a bin for the substitute, meaning its new-bin entries for the substitute outnumber its bin removal entries for it, and the substitute's latest bin set entry on that program, the one carrying the highest bin request reference, is flagged critical, the factor is the critical-bin backup factor; when that program carries a bin for the substitute and that entry is not flagged critical, the factor is the plain-bin backup factor; otherwise the factor is one.

The critical-bin backup factor is 0.7; the plain-bin backup factor is 0.85.

**Input, judgement, result.**

- Active program at the ship-to, more new-bin entries than removal entries for the substitute, latest bin set entry flagged critical: 0.7.
- Same, latest bin set entry not flagged critical: 0.85.
- Active program whose new-bin entries for the substitute do not outnumber its removal entries: 1.
- No active program at the ship-to: 1.
